metadata.title: Ball Sort
metadata.description: Sort colored balls into tubes - each tube should contain only one color
metadata.instructions: Tap a tube to pick up the top ball, then tap another tube to drop it. You can only drop on the same color or an empty tube.

rules.name: Pick up ball from tube when in idle state
Drop ball into tube when holding
Cancel pickup when tapping same tube
Check win condition after each move
Show level complete dialog after animation delay
Advance to next level when Next Level clicked
Replay current level when Replay clicked
